description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa near centre of living zone facing the dining/TV area; an armchair to the right side near the window. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing a home office (no desk or dedicated work space); people requiring a bathtub (shower only); those wanting privacy between sleeping and living (open plan, bedroom accessed through living).
